scope: BR5 measured-CFA confidence experiment over frozen BR3

freeze.policy: BR3 unchanged; new BR5 fixed before quality measurements

decision.reason: Category/phase regression bounds pass but the required 20% achromatic false-chroma improvement fails in both splits. Individual scene regressions also remain recorded.

verification.note: Only research modules changed; installed DR6/wb3 bundle retains its prior qualification.

limits: Measured RGB observations in neighboring CFA sites are not co-located; confidence is heuristic, not an aliasing guarantee.
Synthetic ground truth is not calibrated Nikon camera data.
No speed, memory, denoise, highlight reconstruction or camera-profile qualification.
Production recipe, camera matrices and point 6 scope unchanged.
Large isolated error ratios require inspection of their absolute errors, preserved in each result.
